events.description: Chandler Bing says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing are greeting each other with Rachel Green's 'Ta-da' style now, and Chandler Bing likes greeting each other that way.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing should look at the apartment that Rachel Green cleaned.

Rachel Green says Rachel Green cleaned the apartment, did the windows and the floors, and used all the vacuum attachments except the little round bristle attachment, whose purpose Rachel Green does not know.
Ross Geller says nobody knows what the little round bristle vacuum attachment is for.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing are not supposed to ask what the little round bristle vacuum attachment is for.
Rachel Green says Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing are thinking about how the cleaned apartment looks.
All (Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing) say the apartment looks very clean and great.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller sees that Rachel Green moved the green ottoman.
Monica Geller says the green ottoman was moved and asks how that happened.
Rachel Green says Rachel Green thought the green ottoman looked better in the new position and that the green ottoman also serves as an extra seat around the coffee table.

Monica Geller says Monica Geller, Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing should look at how the green ottoman looks in its old spot and should leave the green ottoman in the old spot for a while.
Phoebe Buffay says Rachel Green tried to move the green ottoman.
Chandler Bing says Rachel Green did not try to fan out the magazines.
Chandler Bing says Monica Geller would scratch Rachel Green's eyes out if Rachel Green tried to fan out the magazines.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is not that obsessive about the apartment.
Phoebe Buffay says Monica Geller is that obsessive.
Phoebe Buffay says Phoebe Buffay lived with Monica Geller and that Monica Geller behaved obsessively like a constant alarm going 'Ree! Ree!'.
Phoebe Buffay says Monica Geller should remember that Phoebe Buffay lived with Monica Geller.
Monica Geller says Phoebe Buffay's accusation that Monica Geller is overly controlling is unfair.
Ross Geller says that when Ross Geller and Monica Geller were kids, Monica Geller's Raggedy Ann doll was the only one that was not raggedy.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller is responsible and organized but can be a kook.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller should imagine that the phone bill arrives and Monica Geller does not pay it right away.
Ross Geller says that in this imagined scenario, Monica Geller, being a kook, waits until the phone company sends Monica Geller a notice before paying the phone bill.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller could wait until the phone company sends a notice before paying the phone bill.
Rachel Green says Monica Geller lets Rachel Green go grocery shopping, and Rachel Green buys laundry detergent that does not have the easy-pour spout.
Monica Geller says one might wonder why someone would buy laundry detergent that does not have the easy-pour spout.
Chandler Bing says someone leaves a glass on the coffee table without a coaster on a hot day, and little beads of condensation inch toward the surface of the wood.
Monica Geller tells Ross Geller, Joey Tribbiani, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, and Chandler Bing to stop and says the accusations about Monica Geller's obsessive behavior are true.
Ross Geller says Monica Geller is Judy Geller.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani will be there, that the phone call was from Joey Tribbiani's agent, and that Joey Tribbiani's agent just got Joey Tribbiani a job in the new Al Pacino movie.
Monica Geller asks what part Joey Tribbiani will play in the Al Pacino movie.
Joey Tribbiani says Al Pacino is the reason Joey Tribbiani became an actor.
Joey Tribbiani says that just when Joey Tribbiani thought he was out, unspecified people pulled Joey Tribbiani back in.
Joey Tribbiani starts to say that Joey Tribbiani is Al Pacino's butt double.
Rachel Green asks what Joey Tribbiani is saying Joey Tribbiani is for Al Pacino.
Joey Tribbiani says Joey Tribbiani is Al Pacino's butt double and plays Al Pacino's butt when Al Pacino goes into the shower.
Joey Tribbiani says the butt-double job is in a real movie with Al Pacino and that this is a big deal.
Chandler Bing says the job is terrific, that Joey Tribbiani deserves it after years of struggling, and that Joey Tribbiani has cracked his way into show business.
Joey Tribbiani says everyone can make jokes and Joey Tribbiani does not care because the job is a big break for Joey Tribbiani.

Ross Geller says Joey Tribbiani is right that the opportunity is big and asks whether Joey Tribbiani will invite Ross Geller, Phoebe Buffay, Rachel Green, Monica Geller, and Chandler Bing to the big opening.
